name: morpho-builder
description: Build and review Morpho Vault V2 Earn, Blue variable-rate borrow, and Midnight fixed-rate borrow integrations with product-specific SDK, data, UX, safety, and checker guidance

interface.longDescription: Guidance for developers building and reviewing Morpho Vault V2 Earn, Blue variable-rate borrow and Midnight fixed-rate borrow integrations. Includes SDK, data, UX, safety and checker guidance. This plugin contains skills only; it does not connect to an MCP server or execute transactions.
capabilities: Morpho Vault V2: build/review earn integrations where users deposit loan assets (e.g. stablecoins) to earn yield
Morpho Blue: build/review variable-rate market integrations for stablecoin loans against crypto collateral
Morpho Midnight: build/review fixed-rate market integrations for stablecoin loans against crypto collateral
